entries.source: You require a tail-mounted steamgun for this talent.
entries.target: 你必须在尾部安装蒸汽枪才能使用这一技能。

entries.source:
A small automatic detection system is always looking for incoming projectiles, when one is about to hit you it injects drugs into your system to boost your reactivity, granting you a free turn.
		This effect can not happen more than once every 5 turns.
entries.target:
在身上安装一个小型自动投射物监测系统。每当一个投射物即将击中你时，它会注射药物来强化你的反应能力，给你一个额外回合。
		该效果每 5 回合最多触发一次。

entries.source: Wielding two huge steamguns this giant is amazingly elusive and agile for his size. Oh and very deadly!
entries.target: 这位手持两把巨型蒸汽枪的巨人，以他的体型而言敏捷得惊人，极难捉摸。而且十分致命！

entries.source:
You repurpose your steam engine to emit a cloud of toxic, corrosive chemicals around you.
		Each time you use a non-instant steamtech talent, you create a radius 3 cloud of miasma for 5 turns. All enemies within the miasma have %d%% reduced healing and %d%% chance to fail talent usage.
		Each time miasma is reapplied the failure chance increases, up to %d%% after 5 reapplications.
		The first time each turn a target affected by miasma is hit by a melee or ranged attack the miasma seeps into their wounds, dealing an additional %0.2f acid damage.
		Miasma duration does not increase on re-apply.
		When a creature survives the miasma it becomes immune to it for 9 turns.
entries.target:
你改造蒸汽机，使其在你周围释放出一团有毒且具有腐蚀性的化学云雾。
		每当你使用一个非瞬发的蒸汽科技技能的时候，你会在周围产生半径为 3 码的瘴气，持续 5 回合。所有被包裹入瘴气的敌人治疗效果减少 %d%%， 且会有 %d%% 的几率使用技能失败。
		瘴气效果叠加的时候，这一技能使用失败的几率也会上升，最多叠加五次，达到 %d%%。
		当被瘴气影响的目标每回合第一次被近战或远程攻击击中的时候，瘴气会渗入他们的伤口，造成 %0.2f 额外的酸性伤害。
		再次施加瘴气时，持续时间不会延长。
		当一个生物在瘴气效果中存活下来后，它会免疫瘴气效果 9 回合。

entries.source: Creates a wall %d units long for %d turns, reflecting all projectiles that hit it and blocking sight.
entries.target: 创造一堵长度为 %d 的墙，持续 %d 回合，反射所有击中此墙的飞行物并且阻挡视线。

entries.source: The Mecharachnid is out of sight of the annihilator; direct control will be lost!
entries.target: 机械蜘蛛已脱离歼灭者视野；将失去直接控制！

entries.source: Fire out an orb of light that deals %0.2f light damage and then returns, dealing the same amount of damage again and reducing the cooldown by half (%d) when it reaches you. The damage will increase with your spellpower. The ball will travel at most %d distance to return to you.
entries.target: 发射一个光球造成 %0.2f 的光伤害然后折返，再次造成相同的伤害，并在回到你身边时使冷却时间减少一半 (%d)。伤害受法术强度加成。球体最多飞行 %d 码后折返回你身边。

entries.source: This guard stands tall and proud, wearing the symbol of the Sunwall.
entries.target: 这个身着太阳堡垒徽记的守卫挺拔而骄傲地站立着。

entries.source:
Project a radius %d vortex of superheated air, dealing %0.2f fire damage and pulling targets towards you.
		The damage will increase with your Steampower.
entries.target:
在半径 %d 码范围内喷出灼热空气构成的漩涡，造成 %0.2f 火焰伤害，并将目标拉向你。
		伤害受蒸汽强度加成。

entries.source:
You tessellate your cloak with small pieces of metal, providing %d damage reduction against all attacks.
		The myriad metal scraps also help against incoming projectiles, providing a %d%% chance of deflecting them to a nearby spot.
entries.target:
在披风上布满小块金属，对所有攻击提供 %d 的伤害减免。
		大量的金属碎片还能帮助抵御飞来的投射物，有 %d%% 的概率将其偏转至附近的位置。

entries.source:
Mount capacitors to your shield that dampen the impact of attacks, increasing block value by %d%% and storing 100%% of the damage blocked as an electrical charge (to a maximum of %d).
Activating this ability discharges blocked damage, firing a bolt of lightning dealing %d%% shield damage as lightning to the first target, then projecting a bolt of lightning that arcs to %d other targets dealing lightning damage equal to the stored amount.
If at maximum charge, this also dazes for 2 turns and the shield strike is a guarenteed critical hit.
The maximum damage you can absorb will increase with your Steampower.
entries.target:
将电容器放置在你的盾牌上，它们可以减弱攻击的影响。增加 %d%% 的格挡值，并将所格挡伤害的 100%% 转化为电力充能（最多充能 %d 点）。
启动这一技能将会释放所格挡的伤害，并发射出一道闪电冲击，对第一个目标造成 %d%% 闪电盾牌伤害，并产生一股电弧，对最多 %d 个其他目标产生相当于你存储的伤害量的伤害。
如果你的伤害充能满了，被击中的目标还会被眩晕 2 回合，且盾牌攻击必定暴击。
你能够吸收的最大伤害量受蒸汽强度加成。

entries.source: The target is covered in burning chemicals, taking %0.2f fire damage each turn. Subsequent shots deal %0.2f fire damage, and if they fall below 25%% life they have a %d%% chance to panic.
entries.target: 目标身上沾满了燃烧的化学物质，每回合受到 %0.2f 火焰伤害。之后的射击会造成 %0.2f 火焰伤害；若目标生命值低于 25%%，则有 %d%% 的几率慌乱逃跑。

entries.source: While normally wielding a steamgun loaded with experimental ammunition and an electrically charged shield, they can equip heavy weapons such as flamethrowers.
entries.target: 他们通常手持装填了实验性弹药的蒸汽枪和一面电力充能的盾牌，但他们也可以装备像火焰喷射器那样的重装武器。

entries.source: Grab the target and pull them towards you, striking for %d%% unarmed melee damage, and if you hit, pinning them for %d turns.
entries.target: 抓住目标并将其拉向你，造成 %d%% 的徒手伤害，如果命中，目标定身 %d 回合。

entries.source:
Throw a grenade at your foes, dealing %0.2f physical damage in radius %d.
		Creatures hit will also be stunned for %d turns.
		The stun effect is applied with your Steampower.
entries.target:
向你的敌人投掷手榴弹，造成 %0.2f 物理伤害，半径 %d 码。
　　被击中的生物还会被震慑 %d 回合。
　　震慑强度受蒸汽强度加成。

entries.source: "So we were thinking. You know what's better than saws? Really BIG saws. Unfortunately, no one could lift them. So we came up with an innovative new solution: Mount them on a motorized platform, allowing easy transportation and unparalleled cutting power!"
entries.target: 我们曾经这么想：你知道比锯子更好的是什么吗？巨大的锯子。可惜没人能够拿得动它们。所以我们想了一个新颖的主意：将它们安装在一个机动平台上，既便于运输，又能获得无与伦比的切割能力。

entries.source:
Deploy a defensive emplacement around you, summoning 2 guardian turrets in adjacent tiles for %d turns. Guardian turrets redirect %d%% of all damage taken by other adjacent allies (other than fellow guardian turrets) to themselves, and each is armed with a powerful turret capable of firing piercing bullets.
			Guardian Turrets gain %0.2f ranks in Steamgun Mastery based on your Hunker Down talent level.
entries.target:
进入守备模式，在身边召唤 2 个守卫炮台，持续 %d 回合。守卫炮台会将身边盟友（不包括其他守卫炮台）所受全部伤害的 %d%% 转移到自己身上，并且它们装备有能发射贯穿子弹的强力炮塔。
			守卫炮台获得 %0.2f 级蒸汽枪掌握，等级取决于你的炮台守卫技能等级。

entries.source: Create a circle of cursed ground (radius %d) for %d turns. Any foes inside will be cursed, all new negative effects on them will have their duration doubled.
entries.target: 创造一片诅咒之地（半径 %d 码），持续 %d 回合。任何陷入其中的敌人都会被诅咒，他们新获得的所有负面状态持续时间都会翻倍。

entries.source:
Ritches are giant insects native to the arid wastes of the southern parts of the Far East.
Vicious predators, they inject corrupting diseases into their foes, and their sharp claws cut through most armours.
entries.target:
里奇是原产于远东南部干旱地区的一种巨型昆虫。
它们是凶残的猎食者，会将腐败的疾病注入敌人体内，锋利的爪子能刺穿大部分盔甲。

entries.source: A withered Whitehoof, with two horns that curve over his head and spiral into a cone.  The tip of his "horn" glows intensely, but is slowly fading; he acts confident, but his darting, wild eyes reveal panic behind them.
entries.target: 一个干瘪的白蹄，他的两只角在头上弯曲，螺旋合拢成锥形。角尖发出强烈的闪光，但正逐渐消退。他努力让自己显得充满自信，但他飘忽不定的眼神展露出了内心的恐惧。
